candidate.title: Capability registry silently falls back to no-op checks when a provider is missing or unregistered (CAP_MARGIN_CHECK and CAP_BALANCE_CHECK are 'preferred, not required')

ice.exploit_path: Perp deployment where CAP_MARGIN_CHECK provider unregistered (or pre-wiring window); registerPlugin does not enforce a provider -> _marginCheck() falls back to NullMarginCheck no-op.

evidence.attacker_model: An off-chain operator (or any state submitted by the trusted batcher during a misconfiguration window) extracts collateral / opens positions past maintenance margin because the margin check is a no-op.
evidence.preconditions: Perp deployment where CAP_MARGIN_CHECK provider unregistered (or pre-wiring window); registerPlugin does not enforce a provider -> _marginCheck() falls back to NullMarginCheck no-op.
evidence.who_gains: Anyone acting on a deployment with unwired CAP_MARGIN_CHECK
evidence.impact: On a perp profile with no (or temporarily no) CAP_MARGIN_CHECK provider, undercollateralized trades/withdrawals are silently allowed -> protocol insolvency / bad debt. The safety net is opt-out by omission rather than fail-closed.
evidence.suggested_fix: Enforce required capability providers at registerPlugin; refuse to process margin-gated txTypes when no real CAP_MARGIN_CHECK/CAP_BALANCE_CHECK provider is registered.
